advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test that drives a genuine non-fast-forward exhausting all retries and asserts the final 'failed after N retries' warning carries the rejection reason and the unpushed-backlog suffix.
evidence: push.py:366-371 `logger.warning("tickets branch push failed after %s retries: %s%s", _MAX_RETRIES, stderr, _unpushed_summary(...))`
All four new tests use `rejecting_origin` whose pre-receive hook declines -> `_is_non_fast_forward` returns False -> terminal at push.py:233, never reaching the retry-exhaustion branch
ABSENCE: no test in tests/unit/test_push_rejection_surfacing.py constructs a genuine non-fast-forward that survives 3 merge attempts to exit via push.py:366
push.py:362-364 comment claims `(test_epoch_guard_matrix / test_epoch_guard_reconciliation) prove this line is ABSENT`
search_files for `test_epoch_guard_reconciliation` matches only the push.py comment; the file itself is absent (read_file returned 'No such file or directory')
Only tests/unit/test_epoch_guard_matrix.py:198 `assert "failed after 3 retries" not in caplog.text` actually exists
advisory.finding: The retry-exhaustion terminal branch (the 'failed after %s retries' warning) now interpolates the git rejection reason and the unpushed-backlog suffix, but no test exercises this branch. All four new tests hit the policy-decline path (push.py:233), which is terminal on the first attempt; none drives a genuine non-fast-forward that fails to converge across all _MAX_RETRIES to reach push.py:366-371. This is the exact line bug 2a76 says previously emitted a bare retry count, so a regression that dropped the `stderr`/`_unpushed_summary` interpolation on it would go undetected.
merged_from: The 'appended, never reworded' safety claim for the 'failed after N retries' wording cites two guarding negative assertions, but only one exists. tests/unit/test_epoch_guard_reconciliation.py (cited in both the commit message and the push.py source comment at line 363) is not present in the repo, so half the stated regression guard for the reworded warning line is missing.

evidence: push.py:124-127 `if res.returncode != 0 or not count.isdigit(): count = "unknown"` and `except Exception: count = "unknown"`
